scope: Profile-scoped persisted deterministic AI-work thresholds and caps, connected settings UI, and a no-call preview over stored match scores. Does not claim a production model consumer.

candidate.status: Source commits pushed and full local validation passed; non-force fast-forward integration pending live main/worktree reconciliation.

acceptance.profile_policy_read_write_and_defaults: PASS - profiles without a saved row use deterministic defaults: score 75, scan cap 5,000, AI cap 75 and reviewed-document cap 20; saved policy reloads after Store/API restart.
acceptance.profile_isolation: PASS - a policy saved for one profile does not appear in a second profile.
acceptance.bounds_and_privacy: PASS - strict validation rejects invalid ranges, document cap above AI cap, attempts to raise 75/20 caps, secret-shaped extra fields and over-limit job batches; validation errors do not echo submitted values.
acceptance.read_only_preview: PASS - preview counts profile jobs against the scan cap, applies the integer score threshold conservatively, counts only jobs with a stored deterministic score, leaves unscored jobs unknown, and reports counts only. It performs no provider call and creates no documents.
acceptance.connected_browser_flow: PASS - controls save/reload per profile, preview reflects deterministic jobs, failed settings reads keep controls disabled, and the narrow viewport remains usable.
acceptance.production_ai_consumer_and_document_disp: PARTIAL - no matching/job task consumer reads the saved policy to run a model or create documents; the preview is not presented as execution. Requirement remains open.

local_validation.environment: Windows local worktree, Python 3.12.10, repository-locked frontend dependencies, connected Chromium. SQLite temporary databases and a task-created PostgreSQL 17 container bound only to 127.0.0.1 used synthetic data; that container was removed.

expected_red_and_recovered_failures: New API tests initially got 404 before routes existed; final focused tests pass.
Browser acceptance initially found the AI cost panel missing; final connected browser suites pass.
A threshold boundary test exposed 74.99 rounding up to 75; preview now truncates nonnegative stored match scores conservatively and the regression passes.
A missing stored match score is now excluded as unknown rather than treated as zero; scan accounting still includes the job.
A browser outage case found fallback defaults remained editable after policy-read failure; final UI keeps controls disabled until a successful read.

A persistence test initially disposed the replacement Store rather than the TestClient's original Store; the fixture now closes the client, disposes the owner, reopens the database, and verifies API readback.
not_run: No real Ollama inference or production AI task consumer was invoked; no prompts/profile/job descriptions were sent to a model.
Remote/paid AI providers, GitHub Actions, hosted tests/reviews and cloud automation were NOT_RUN under the active local-only policy.
External job application submission remained OFF; no submission path was added or invoked.

limitations: Cost policy is persisted and previewed but is not yet consumed by a production matching/model worker.
The preview does not infer a score for jobs whose deterministic match record is missing and does not create document candidates automatically.
Issue #111 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; full product completion requires a real, reviewed task-consumer workflow.
